name: William Gladstone
role: British Liberal leader and prime minister
bio: The British Liberal leader figured in the Cow Boy's foreign news in 1885, which criticized his handling of the dispute with Russia and suggested he let his government fall on purpose. In February 1886 the paper reported him forming a new cabinet after defeating Lord Salisbury, with Irish home rule as the price of Parnell's support.
